output:
**No, not while the rules stand.** `is.waiwai.dictation` is permanent because macOS ties Accessibility grants to the bundle ID. An app with the new ID looks like a new app, so every existing install would need Accessibility granted again.

If nobody has installed a build yet, that risk is mostly gone. The invariant still says permanent, though, so changing it is your call and needs an edit to the rules file first. I can't check from here whether any builds have gone out.

If you want the new name shown to people, change `CFBundleDisplayName` instead. That doesn't affect permissions.
